name: Headspace
one_liner: Guided meditation and mindfulness app with courses for stress, sleep and focus, sleep sounds and short daily exercises.
best_for: Beginners who want structured, short guided meditations
People dealing with everyday stress or trouble winding down for sleep
People whose employer or health plan provides it free
not_for: Anyone in crisis or thinking about suicide: call or text 988
People with moderate or severe depression, anxiety or PTSD who need treatment from a clinician
People who want their health app data kept out of advertising
short_description: Subscription meditation app with guided courses for stress, sleep and focus. $69.99/year; often free through employers.
long_description: Headspace is a mindfulness app with guided meditations from a few minutes long, multi-day courses on stress, anxiety, sleep and focus, sleepcasts and sounds, movement sessions and focus music. Beginners start with a basics course. It is a self-guided subscription: $69.99 a year for one person, with family and student plans, and it is widely offered through employers. The same company also offers therapy and text-based coaching, which are separate services. Randomized trials, several funded or run by Headspace, have found improvements in stress, wellbeing and irritability with app use. Its privacy policy says it shares personal information with advertising partners, which some state laws treat as a sale.
patient_summary: You pick short guided meditations, courses on stress, anxiety or sleep, sleepcasts and focus music, and do a few minutes a day on your phone. It is a self-guided subscription app, about $70 a year; many employers and some health plans offer it free. Headspace also sells therapy and coaching separately.

pricing.notes: Headspace lists 2026 rates of $69.99/year (Solo), $99/year (Family) and $9.99/year (Student, eligible countries). The $12.99 monthly price is from third-party reviews. Free trials are offered; promotional prices renew at full price. Often free through employers.

privacy.notes: Policy (effective March 2026) says it does not sell for payment but shares personal information with advertising partners for targeted ads, which some state laws count as a sale.

seo.title: Headspace: Meditation & Mindfulness App | HeyPsych
seo.meta_description: Headspace is a meditation and mindfulness app offering guided sessions, sleep content, and focus music to improve mental wellness.

faqs.a: Headspace costs approximately $70/year or $13/month after a free trial. Students get 85% off. Many employers provide Headspace free through workplace benefits. A limited free version offers some content without subscription.

Multiple peer-reviewed studies show Headspace reduces stress, improves focus, and enhances well-being. It's one of the most researched meditation apps. However, it's a wellness tool—not a substitute for clinical treatment of diagnosed mental health conditions.

Headspace Health is the company formed when Headspace merged with Ginger (clinical mental health platform). Headspace Health offers the meditation app plus clinical services (therapy, psychiatry, coaching) for employers and health plans.

Both are excellent meditation apps. Headspace has more structured courses and an educational approach. Calm emphasizes sleep content and celebrity narration. Try both free trials—personal preference matters more than objective differences.
